description: Community-maintained public Congressional person identifiers and dated House/Senate terms; first 100 source rows only

source.publisher: unitedstates/congress-legislators contributors (community, not official Congress publisher)

sampling.criteria: First 100 entries in the published current-member file in source order, including their published historical terms. File membership is not a verified current-office status.

coverage.scope: US congressional directory sample; neither a full US nor a global person universe

access.probe: HTTP 200 on 2026-09-15; bounded prefix read, not a retained acquisition
access.credentials: No credentials required by verified endpoint probe; access policies may change

normalization.raw_fields: source_row on person; source_term or source_affiliation on role; all claims retain raw line evidence
normalization.identity: Only published identifier crosswalks; names are aliases, never merge evidence
